# thalassa_project (Resource)

Create and manage a project in the Thalassa Cloud platform

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "thalassa_project" "example" {
  name        = "example-project"
  description = "An example project"

  labels = {
    environment = "development"
  }
}

output "project_id" {
  value = thalassa_project.example.id
}

output "project_slug" {
  value = thalassa_project.example.slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Project

### Optional

- `annotations` (Map of String) Annotations for the Project
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the Project
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels for the Project
- `organisation_id` (String) Organisation of the Project. If not provided, the organisation of the (Terraform) provider will be used.
- `parent_project_identity` (String) Identity of the parent project, if this project is nested

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp of the Project (RFC3339)
- `id` (String) Identity of the Project
- `object_version` (Number) Object version of the Project
- `slug` (String) Slug of the Project
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp of the Project (RFC3339)
